video_title: Philadelphia 76ers Practice Media Availability 🎙️ | Labaron Philon Jr.  | 10.19.26

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on his first NBA game nerves and preparation
quotes.excerpt: definitely getting all that out the way and just like focusing on winning the game
quotes.quote: I think it's going to be a pretty good game. For me, playing in the Garden last year as a college game type of thing for Alabama, but I think this time it's going to be more people, more fans, more exciting, and I'll say more nerves definitely for the first game. But definitely getting all that out the way and just like focusing on winning the game, focusing on helping my team do whatever we need to do to win the game, and make sure everybody is ready and prepared.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr admits to some first game nerves ahead of his NBA debut but says his focus is entirely on helping the team win

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on the intensity of early season NBA matchups
quotes.excerpt: I really haven't seen these kind of matchups throughout the NBA like it is this year
quotes.quote: Growing up as a kid, just watching all the first games, and I really haven't seen these kind of matchups throughout the NBA like it is this year. You got a lot of teams that played each other last year in the playoffs and stuff like that, playing each other for the first game. So I feel like both teams are really going to try to impose their will and be battle-tested, so we got to see who come out on top.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr notes the intensity of this year's opening matchups saying both teams are going to try to impose their will and be battle tested

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on the motivation of playing defending champions
quotes.excerpt: you can't get no better motivation after seeing that and stepping on the floor
quotes.quote: They are getting their rings. I feel like that's exciting for our group to just see that and being on the other side of it, experiencing. I would say you can't get no better motivation after seeing that and stepping on the floor and playing against them. I feel like it's going to wake some of our guys up to want to play at that level as well. So, seeing that, definitely for a rookie, I feel like I'll be motivated to give it my all.
quotes.social_post: Watching the opponent get their rings is all the motivation Labaron Philon Jr needs for his first NBA game saying you cannot get better motivation than that

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on team engagement and player readiness
quotes.excerpt: everybody got different skill levels and we can use it like when it come to late game situations
quotes.quote: The coaches for sure, the way they plan things and prep us for things, but the players as well, being engaged all through practice and for the whole time. I feel like that's very important just because you might got a lot of guys that's sitting on the sideline, but they might be in the game in a special situation or something that we need them to do like set a screen or make a pass. Everybody got different skill levels and we can use it like when it come to late game situations like that.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr emphasizes the importance of team engagement in practice noting that every player needs to be ready for special situations

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on team defensive focus and rebounding
quotes.excerpt: all five guys that step on the floor you got to defend
quotes.quote: I would definitely say on the rebounding level, just everybody getting in there trying to make a play on the ball. On the defensive side, just being on a screen, I think our guys are really well-spoken and they love to communicate on defense. We have to be on a screen for it all to go right and all five guys that step on the floor you got to defend. So, I think Coach Nurse has really harped on that and all the guys every time they step on the floor, everybody is trying to make the impact on that side of the ball.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr says Coach Nurse has been harping on defensive communication and rebounding as key areas for the team this season

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on his rookie mentality and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: I'm a young guy so I got to go ten times harder
quotes.quote: For myself, just staying level-headed, staying ready, being ready to come in and work every day. That's been kind of my motive and my mentality of just coming in and working. Seeing all these great guys on the team and stuff like that, that gave me extra motivation to come out there and try to work as hard as them. I'm a young guy so I got to go ten times harder. So for me being a young guy, really just having that mentality that I'm going to work as hard as everybody around me and try to make somebody else better.
quotes.social_post: As a rookie Labaron Philon Jr says his mentality is to work ten times harder than everyone else to keep up with the veterans on the team
